sources: recreation.gov public search API campsite catalog for facility 233930 (11 sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for facility 233930 (all 11 sites NONELECTRIC, 'Water Hookup' No on every site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 10 single-family sites plus one group tent-only area (site 12, up to 25 people). 'This Campground is not recommended for RV's over 30' in length'; average parking spur 14 x 30 ft; catalog lengths 20-30 ft (six sites 30 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/snowbank-campground ('Sites: 11', 'Average Parking Spur: 14' x 30'') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233930 ('one GROUP CAMPING AREA (SITE 12) that can accommodate up to 25 people', 'This Campground is not recommended for RV's over 30' in length') + catalog, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water, trash collection and recycling, food storage locker; firewood $10/bundle. No showers; no dump station at any ExplorUS-run Custer Gallatin campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233930 ('vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection', 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground', 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest', amenities) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/snowbank-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26 a single site including 2 vehicles (or an RV/trailer and tow vehicle); $9 each additional vehicle. Group site $60.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233930/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26, GROUP $60) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/snowbank-campground ('$26.00 includes 2 driving vehicles $9.00 each additional vehicle'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run by ExplorUS under Forest Service permit. All 11 sites are reservable on recreation.gov, until 4 days before arrival; reserved sites are held until check-out time the day after arrival. 16-night limit.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/snowbank-campground ('Make Reservations Here') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233930 (notices; contact email @goexplorus.com; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 4; catalog 11 of 11 reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Yellowstone Ranger District) campground on the banks of Mill Creek in the West Absaroka Mountains, ~29 mi S of Livingston: US-89 south to the Pray turnoff, then ~11 mi east on Mill Creek Rd (FR 486). Reopened May 2025 after the access bridge was repaired. --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups, vault toilets, 30-ft RV limit, $26 (2026), reservable. Changed site count 10 -> 11 (10 singles + group tent area), with the breakdown in sites.note. Added drinking water, no showers/dump, season 5/15-9/25, recreation.gov platform for this campground (was inherited), 16-night limit, ExplorUS concession. Not stated: sewer (derived false left), booking window (180 inherited left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: the concessionaire ExplorUS, (661) 702-1420 (recreation.gov contact info); recreation.gov's facility phone is 406-646-1012. The Forest Service page gives only the Supervisor's Office, 406-587-6710.
Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov says the campground 'is located on the banks of Mill Creek' and lists 'Creek Access'; the entry is 'riverview'.

Forest Service fee block contradicts itself ('Single Site: $20 (includes 2 driving vehicles)', 'Extra Vehicle Fee: $8' vs '$26.00 includes 2 driving vehicles $9.00 each additional vehicle'); recreation.gov's 2026-2027 rate table says $26, so $26 was written.
